requirements.requirement: Certified VRS providers provide Internet-based TRS without unauthorized voluntary service interruptions.

A voluntary interruption lasting 30 minutes or more requires prior Commission authorization requested at least 60 days in advance with justification, customer-notice plan, and service-resumption plan.
CGB grants or denies a planned-interruption request at least 35 days before the proposed interruption.

An unforeseen interruption beyond provider control, or a voluntary interruption under 30 minutes, requires written CGB notification within two business days of commencement and accessible consumer service-status notice updated timely.
If service is not restored when the first report is filed, a second report is due within two business days of restoration explaining restoration.

Failure to obtain required prior authorization or provide required interruption notice may expose a provider to revocation, Fund-payment suspension, or other Commission enforcement; Baudot must not choose the enforcement outcome.
